# Epigraph {.unnumbered .unlisted .oculto}

::: {.epigrafe}
“No bird soars in a calm.”

 — Wilbur Wright, *Observations on Soaring* (notes from his diary, around September 1900), aviation pioneer and co-inventor of the first working powered aeroplane.
:::
